headline: NASA Accelerates Moon Station Program with $20 Billion Investment
summary: NASA is accelerating its return to the Moon with a crewed lunar landing target in 2028 and approximately $20 billion committed to establishing a lasting human presence.
why: Large government space exploration budgets drive major procurement contracts for aerospace and defense contractors.

impacts.name: Aerospace & Defense
impacts.why: Government space agency funding flows directly into aerospace contractor development budgets.
